# Build retrospective of Generated files are rebuilt when work lands instead of sending it back

Document: spec/changes/generated-files-are-rebuilt-when-work-lands-instead-of-sending-it-back/spec.json (spdoc-ce4fd0e56b1a)
Made: 2026-11-08T01:11:46.562332+00:00

## Lessons

- A spec that changes what happens to a merge conflict must list every place the Hub refuses or decides a merge. That includes the approval gate (requirement_gate._check_mergeable), the approval preview in api/v1/tasks.py, the check run before review, the landing batch, the PR push and the no-checks land_by_merge path. (cites: amd-07828af71a6c, run-984d99193a39)
- Adding a field to project settings requires updating the exact-dict assertion in hub/tests/test_operator_projects_api.py::test_project_settings_update_is_validated_and_atomic. The spec should name that file in the setting task. (cites: chk-840284494d37, ttr-b008a7e2da99)
- The shape of any new record field, such as regenerated as an object with paths and seconds, should be stated in the spec so builders and the drive agree from the start. (cites: run-6f29e1aa2166)
- When an amendment adds a task for work that an in-flight task has already absorbed, the new task ends up as pure verification. The amendment should say so, or fold the change into the existing task's files. (cites: amd-07828af71a6c, ev-07524f3c161d)
- Sibling tasks that edit the same test file will force a merge-needed send-back on the later one, so the spec should give shared test edits to one task. (cites: ttr-f02253966c27, ev-1928eec1dad7)

## What to improve

- [code_and_checks] Configure ruff as a fast check at completion so lint errors like W605 are caught in the builder's turn rather than by a pre-review send-back. (cites: ttr-622bd39a1695, chk-66bb1840be10)
- [code_and_checks] Stabilise or quarantine the recurring flaky Hub tests, especially test_a_slow_project_open_does_not_block_other_requests, so hub-tests runs do not pay for first-run failures. (cites: chk-ac117ac64bef, chk-75b31bc4c0e4)
- [code_and_checks] Add the operator settings API test to the sweep set, or make its settings assertion tolerant of new fields, so a new setting fails before landing rather than in the landing batch. (cites: chk-840284494d37, chk-708671dcde09)
- [specs] Have specs that touch merging enumerate all conflict and refusal points, including the approval gate, approval preview and no-checks landing path, along with the exact shape of any new record field. (cites: amd-07828af71a6c, run-984d99193a39, run-6f29e1aa2166)
- [staffing_and_running] Do not start runs on tasks whose dependencies have not landed. GFARW-3 and GFARW-4 both ran early, against stand-ins and scratch merges. (cites: run-984d99193a39, run-39270840c9bf)
- [tooling] Make submit_checkpoint_notes accept a string where it expects a list, or return a clearer schema error. (cites: run-ed3a6cea7d50, ckpt-38d8dfd10162)
- [tooling] Report merge-needed refusals with the actual conflicting paths, and re-check whether the branch already contains the commit, since GFARW-3's reported conflict did not reproduce. (cites: ttr-f02253966c27, ckpt-e246b08bbae5)
- [tooling] Fix check-run timestamps for fully reused runs, which can end before they start, and close check runs that are still marked running after the build finishes. (cites: chk-155fada6cb49, chk-4df0262b6d03)
